    Auslander--Reiten translation on the finite right-module skeleton #

    The kernel of the chosen minimal right almost-split map defines translation from nonprojective to noninjective labels. Injectivity follows from uniqueness of minimal left almost-split maps. Surjectivity follows from the dual cokernel construction at every noninjective label and uniqueness of minimal right almost-split maps.
